parts:
Your faceting variable wasn't named the same thing as the faceting variable. 

names(totals)[1]<-"variable"

ggplot() +
geom_line(data=wintermelt,aes(Date,as.numeric(value)/1000,colour=variable), size=1) +

theme_bw() +   # overrides all colors and axis formatting
scale_x_date(labels= date_format("%b"),breaks = "1 month", minor_breaks = "2 week",expand=c(0,0))+

opts(title="Juvenile Winter Chinook Salmon Estimated Passage"
,legend.position="none"
, axis.text.x = theme_text(angle=45,hjust=1,size=8.2,colour="gray50")
,axis.text.y=theme_text(size=8.2,hjust=1,colour="grey50")
,axis.title.x=theme_text(size=9.0),axis.title.y=theme_text(size=9.0,angle=90))+
